about: Every world on the galaxy and every realm page. coax/web/realms.ts writes realms.coax (the galaxy's table) and realms/<slug>/index.html from it. docs/verse/realm-host.md is the contract.

realm.title: Haunted House
realm.description: The Haunted House, a Verse realm you walk through in the browser: nine haunts to find, characters to talk to, doors to open. The same Coax code as the OpenAgents iOS app.

realm.title: The Grid
realm.description: The Grid, the bare Verse world: a floor of lines out to the dark, the Pylon terminal, the help desk and the gym, robots walking their rounds with the Foreman by the start, and the gate to Everglade.
realm.alt: Enter the Verse: walk the Grid

realm.title: Everglade
realm.description: Everglade, the forest city in a forest you leave only by its trails: walk its streets and rooms, talk to its people, who remember you, and take quests from the board out to the deep wood, the ruins and the river crossing. One of them earns a flock of birds that follows you.
realm.share: A forest city you leave only by its trails: talk to people who remember you, and take quests from the board out to the deep wood, the ruins and the river. In your browser.

realm.title: Fairy Forest
realm.description: Fairy Forest, a park laid out like Central Park, faded round a sleeping heart tree: you are a fairy who wakes in Mossbank, by the Pond. Bloom the grey patches back to colour, help the creatures of the glades and wake the heart tree's roots.
realm.share: You are a fairy who wakes by the Pond in a faded park. Bloom the grey back to colour, help the creatures of the glades and wake the heart tree. In your browser.
realm.alt: Fairy Forest: a fairy with jewel wings on a path in the park, a hedgehog by the trees

realm.title: Dead Gears
realm.description: Dead Gears, a Verse realm in the browser: hold a ship's hold against three waves of crawlers, hounds, reavers and brutes with a cutter that severs limbs, telekinetic lift and stun, and a support engineer, then repair the reactor between waves.
realm.share: Hold a ship's hold against three waves of crawlers, hounds and brutes with a limb-cutting tool and telekinesis, then repair the reactor between waves. In your browser.
realm.alt: Enter the Verse: hold the ship in Dead Gears

realm.line: Hard sci-fi strategy on the real orbits of 2200
realm.title: Belt 2200
realm.description: Belt 2200, a hard sci-fi strategy game in the browser: the solar system in the year 2200 on real orbits. Run the Free Belt's Hearth Station at Ceres, plan burns and coasts with their delta-v, propellant and time, and mine ice while the Mars Union and the Terran Compact fly their own routes.
realm.share: Hard sci-fi strategy on real orbits: run Hearth Station at Ceres in the year 2200, plan burns by their delta-v and mine ice while rival powers fly their routes.
realm.alt: Enter the Verse: the solar system in 2200 in Belt 2200

realm.line: Rocket roadster ball in a glass arena in orbit
realm.title: Orbit League
realm.description: Orbit League, a Verse realm you play in the browser: drive an electric roadster with a rocket boost and play ball against a bot in a glass arena in orbit, where the station spins down to zero-g every 90 seconds.
realm.share: Car ball in orbit: drive a rocket-boosted electric roadster against a bot in a glass arena, where the station spins down to zero-g every 90 seconds. In your browser.
realm.alt: Enter the Verse: play Orbit League, car ball in orbit

realm.title: Fixture Realm
realm.description: The realm host's test world: its own module, its own save slot and its own asset pack, opened from the galaxy like any realm.

realm.title: Water Lab
realm.description: The water system's test scene: a spectral sea breaking on a beach, in the painted water look.

realm.title: A First Realm
realm.description: Where a project made from a drop first opens: the models someone dropped, stood on an empty floor for you to walk among.

realm.title: A Realm You Built
realm.description: A realm someone built from one prompt at /realms/new: only the features they kept, and the tools its owner gives visitors.

realm.line: Open ground everyone builds on together
realm.title: Sandbox
realm.description: The Sandbox, open ground in the Verse that everyone builds on together: press B to edit, move, paint or copy what's there or place crates, barrels, lamps, trees and rocks, and what you build is published for everyone.
realm.share: Open ground in the Verse that everyone builds on together: place crates, lamps, trees and rocks, paint and move them, and what you build is there for everyone.
realm.alt: Enter the Verse: build on the Sandbox's open ground

realm.title: Hecate's Cemetery
realm.description: Hecate's Cemetery, the first expansion of Planetary Villa on the Verse: a moonlit memorial garden you walk with a glowing companion, its tombstones along garden paths and an open field beyond the gate.
realm.share: The first expansion of Planetary Villa: a moonlit memorial garden you walk with a glowing companion, tombstones along its paths and an open field past the gate.

realm.line: Tower defense on the SRD 5e rules
realm.title: Hold the Stair
realm.description: Hold the Stair, a Verse realm in the browser: a popping tower defense on the SRD 5e rules. Bubble-beasts climb a wizard's tower and pop into the layers inside; place fighters, wizards and clerics beside the stair, and every attack rolls a real d20.
realm.share: A popping tower defense on the SRD 5e rules: bubble-beasts climb a wizard's tower, you place fighters, wizards and clerics by the stair, and every attack rolls a d20.
realm.alt: Hold the Stair: bubble-beasts climb the tower stair past a party of adventurers
